Vital Statistics and Documents
Certified copies of Birth, Death and Marriage certificates are available through the Town Clerk's office or online.
Please call or email ahead to place your request.
Office of the Town Clerk
Phone: (508) 867-1421 Ext. 2
Email:
AssistantTownClerk@wbrookfield.com
or
TownClerk@wbrookfield.com
To place an online request,
click here
.
Birth Certificates
Certified copies of a birth certificate for those persons born while residing in West Brookfield are available through the Town Clerk's office.
Copies are $15.00 each.  Please call the Town Clerk's office (508) 867-1421 ext. 2 with the following information:
Name, Date of Birth, number of copies needed and when you will be in to pick them up and a phone number where you can be reached should we have any questions or need additional information in order to process your request.
Death Certificates
Certified copies of a death certificate for those persons who resided in West Brookfield at the time of their death or those who died while in West Brookfield are available through the Town Clerk's office.
Copies are $15.00 each.  Please call the Town Clerk's office (508) 867-1421 ext. 2 with the following information:
Name, Date of Death, number of copies needed and when you will be in to pick them up and a phone number where you can be reached should we have any questions or need additional information in order to process your request.
Marriage Certificates
Certified copies of Marriage Certificates for those persons filied their intentions in West Brookfield are available through the Town Clerks office.
Copies are $15.00 each.  Please call the Town Clerk's office (508) 867-1421 ext. 2 with the following information:
Name/names, Date of Marriage, number of copies needed and when you will be in to pick them up and a phone number where you can be reached should we have any questions or need additional informaiton in order to process your request.

Open Meeting & Conflict of Interest Law
To view the Attorney General's Open Meeting Law Guide
:
Click here
Within two weeks of a member’s election or appointment or the taking of the oath of office, whichever occurs later, all members of public bodies must complete the attached Certificate of Receipt of Open Meeting Law Materials certifying that they have received these materials, and that they understand the requirements of the Open Meeting Law and the consequences of violating it.
Attorney General's Open Meeting Law Guide
To complete the Summary of Conflict of Interest Law Education Requirements:
Click here
Every 2 years, all state, county, and municipal employees must complete a conflict of interest law online training program. Newly elected or appointed public employees must complete this training within 30 days of beginning public service, and every 2 years thereafter.
Conflict of Interest Law for Municipal Employees
POSTING A MEETING AGENDA
Agendas must be posted
at least 48 hours in advance of the public meeting
.  This means the completed agenda must be filed with the Town Clerk's office in advance of the 48 hour deadline to allow time to post.
The
legally required
posting place is the bulletin board outside Town Hall.
The website is a public convenience - but not the legally required place.
As a reminder, the Town Clerk's office is open Mon - Thu, 9am -3pm.
If you email an agenda on Fri/Sat/Sun, it will not be posted until Monda
y.
You may email completed agendas to
TownClerk@wbrookfield.com
and
assistanttownclerk@wbrookfield.com
